Criterion: task resolved (FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS pass). Study 1 (related tasks; task set implied 376), resolved % / cost USD, baseline -> oracle summary: (a) Claude Code + Claude Sonnet 4.5: 19.68 / 0.67 -> 23.40 / 0.55; (b) Codex + GPT-5.3 Codex: 22.60 / 0.31 -> 23.94 / 0.27; (c) Qwen Code + Qwen3.5-plus: 16.22 / 0.33 -> 21.54 / 0.18; (d) Qwen Code + GLM-5: 18.35 / 0.58 -> 19.41 / 0.48; (e) Claude Code + MiniMax 2.7: 19.68 / 0.65 -> 22.07 / 0.46. Oracle summary: quality works (modest), cost works for all. Study 2 (SWE-ContextBench Lite, 99 tasks, Claude Sonnet 4.5; agent not restated), resolved % / time min / cost USD: No-Context 26.26 / 6.37 / 0.79 (baseline); Free Context 26.26 / 6.78 / 0.98 (quality does not work, cost does not work); Oracle Context 27.27 / 5.95 / 0.77 (partly, works); Free Summary 22.22 / 6.28 / 0.91 (does not work, does not work); Oracle Summary 34.34 / 6.66 / 0.85 (works, partly); Mem0 24.24 / 4.72 / 0.62 (does not work, works); OpenViking 29.20 / 4.20 / 0.53 (partly, works); Supermemory 30.30 / 5.04 / 0.58 (works, works); LangMem: retrieval match only (73.34% overall), no resolution reported
fields.why: All numbers checked against Tables 3 and 4 (rebuilt by column order) and the text. Verdicts are judgement calls: Oracle Summary cost 'partly' although its time and cost are both above baseline (6.66 vs 6.37 min, 0.85 vs 0.79 USD), and Oracle Context quality 'partly' for +1.01 points; the author should settle the thresholds

fields.v: Study 1: 5 agent+model configurations x {baseline, oracle summary}. Study 2: Claude Sonnet 4.5 x 5 context settings on 99 Lite tasks (495 runs) + memory frameworks. Baseline: No-Context. Held constant: task prompt template (repo, base commit, problem statement), fresh isolated environment, git history removed, no state carryover. Acceptance tests: FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS from the PR test patch. Repetitions: not stated (apparently one run per task). Human intervention: none

Oracle summaries improved resolution for all five agents (+1.1 to +5.3 points) and lowered cost; best GPT-5.3 Codex 23.94%. On Lite: Oracle Summary best resolution (34.34% vs 26.26%, +8.08); Oracle Context lowest time and cost (5.95 min, 0.77 USD); Free Context +27.3% cost with no gain; Free Summary below baseline; both summary settings cost more than baseline on Lite (0.91, 0.85 vs 0.79 USD); Supermemory best framework (30.30%), OpenViking cheapest (0.53 USD). No significance tests despite 'significantly improve' in the abstract
fields.why: Added that on Lite summary-based reuse did not reduce cost against the baseline (text p. 8: 'summary-based reuse does not reduce cost relative to the baseline'), a result the value left out while saying oracle summaries lowered cost in Study 1

fields.v: Distinguished oracle vs free context and frameworks on resolution and cost. Repeatability: single runs, no variance reported; prompt template given. Limitations stated: no comprehensive human validation of problem statements, test patches or solvability; context pool quality not filtered (noisy trajectories)

Context helps only when compact and correctly selected; free retrieval can hurt. Gaps: summarization quality, structured context management, adaptive decisions on when to reuse, adaptive retrieval, critical use of retrieved context; limitation: lack of human validation of tasks

Tables 3, 4 and 5 jumbled by pdftotext; values rebuilt by column order and cross-checked with text (e.g. GPT-5.3 Codex 22.60/23.94, Claude 23.40, Oracle Summary 34.34, costs 0.77/0.98/0.79/0.91/0.85). Table 4 includes Mem0, OpenViking, Supermemory only, although the text says it compares four frameworks (LangMem missing). Task set for Table 3 (376 related vs other) is not stated explicitly. Agent for Study 2 not restated (only Claude Sonnet 4.5). Abstract claims 'significantly' without statistical tests, and says summarized experience reduces token cost, while on Lite summary reuse cost more than the baseline (p. 8). Text says oracle summaries improve 'most models' while Table 3 shows all five improve. Name misspelled 'SWE-ContxetBench' in headings. Benchmark said to be released (Lite) but no URL in the text. No pre-registration. Languages: 9 (Python dominant)
fields.why: Added two reporting inconsistencies: abstract's cost-reduction claim vs the Lite result (summary settings 0.91/0.85 vs 0.79 USD), and 'most models' vs all five improving in Table 3
